releaseNotes:
• Ultra-Compact Landscape & Gaming Height: Keyboard auto-resizes to slim ~40% screen height in landscape mode with orientation listeners so games and video remain fully visible
• Zero-Latency Typing: 500x faster prefix indexed dictionary lookup and in-place shift un-shifting eliminating keystroke lag
• SoundPool Audio Engine: Instant keystroke clicks (Mechanical, iPhone, Bubble, Wood, Default) working live across all Android versions, default sound MUTED/OFF
• Butter-Smooth Live Themes: Choreographer VSYNC 60FPS sync, zero-allocation ripple pooling, and cached shaders preventing freezing/stutter
• Reliable Background Auto-Update Notifications: Inexact AlarmManager and Boot/Power receivers for dependable background alerts
